limits: This is a standalone development reference, not production CLI/library integration or a credential receiver.
PR_GET_DUMPABLE and target gates are self checks; external proc access/ownership checks observe access-control effects, not actual core suppression or pipe-helper non-dispatch.
Existing G1 remains unmet and Linux live remains NO_GO. No budget is created, reset or reused.
Environment is cleared for native cases; Rust vars_os still internally materializes key/value pairs. Only public bytes are permitted.
Root/CAP_SYS_PTRACE, same Windows user via WSL root, VM memory, swap, WER, relay and pipe-buffer exposures are not excluded.
Source checks and private-build hashes are not complete toolchain/build environment or executable immutability attestation.
External termination or power loss may interrupt guest cleanup; a Windows job alone does not contain Linux descendants.
No ASR, service authorization, durable provisioning, WAN gain, Android parity or perfection conclusion.
Reference is outside the Cargo workspace; core CI for 1d66138 is not a CI qualification of this new reference.

linux_observations.platform: Linux x86_64 under existing development WSL distribution
